meta.name: schema-markup-generator
meta.description: Use when the user asks to "generate schema"; creates JSON-LD for FAQ, HowTo, Article, Product, and LocalBusiness rich-result candidates. Not for title/meta-description tags — use meta-tags-optimizer; not for crawl/index technical issues — use technical-seo-checker. Schema标记/结构化数据

copy.tagline: 为网页生成结构化数据标记
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在网页中添加JSON-LD结构化数据以提升搜索展示效果
copy.tagline_en: Generate structured data markup for web pages
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to add JSON-LD structured data to web pages for better search display

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 能根据页面内容生成 JSON-LD 格式的结构化数据，支持 FAQ、HowTo、Article、Product、LocalBusiness 等类型，并检查富结果资格。
howto.when: 当用户要求“生成 schema”或“创建结构化数据”时触发。

say.text: 为这个页面生成 FAQ 的 schema 标记。
为产品“智能手表”生成 Product schema。
检查并改进这段已有的 schema 标记。
say.note: Claude 会分析并优化你提供的 schema。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can generate JSON-LD structured data based on page content, supporting types like FAQ, HowTo, Article, Product, and LocalBusiness, and check rich result eligibility.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user asks to "generate schema" or "create structured data".

say_en.text: Generate FAQ schema markup for this page.
say_en.note: Claude will output FAQPage JSON-LD code.

say_en.text: Review and improve this existing schema markup.
say_en.note: Claude will analyze and optimize your schema.
